result.summary: Stage 9 Wasm execution unit tests completed. Core infrastructure (CapabilitySet, TimeoutContext, ModuleRegistry, InstancePool) fully tested with 6/6 unit tests passing. Integration testing deferred to Stage 10 pending Wasmtime C API full integration and compiled Wasm test fixtures. All 14 WASM requirements have framework implementation; 6 are unit-tested, 8 require Stage 10 integration testing. No MUST requirement failures.
